title: Screen states contract
description: The non-happy states each data screen shows (ui-states-and-feedback).

actionProp.description: The prop that carries a state's next step on its message element. Default: action.

view.description: The file that renders the states (literal testIDs '<id>.state.<state>').

test.description: The test that renders every declared state.

model.description: Optional: the model hook; importing @tanstack/react-query there counts as readsServer.

stateType.description: The union type whose kinds must equal the declared states plus 'ready'.

isList.description: The content is a collection: 'empty' is required.

hasFilter.description: A filter or search narrows it: 'filtered-empty' is required.

readsServer.description: It reads server state: 'offline' is required.

confirmations.description: Every confirm() the app asks: its literal testID and why Undo cannot replace it.

whyNotUndo.description: What cannot be undone, in one sentence.
